title: Strong Subgraph-Count Stability in $C_{2\ell+1}$-Free Graphs
summary: Starting from the stability theorem of Erdős and Simonovits, stability problems for graphs forbidding a fixed subgraph have been studied in terms of edge numbers, spectral radii and subgraph counts. Let $\mathcal{N}(F,G)$ denote the number of unlabeled copies of $F$ in $G$. It is known that, for every fixed path $P_t$ and even cycle $C_{2a}$, the maximum number of copies in an $n$-vertex $C_{2\ell+1}$-free graph is attained by the bipartite Turán graph $T_{n,2}$. In this paper we obtain strong structural stability for $C_{2\ell+1}$-free graphs in terms of copies of paths and even cycles. For…
